timing.heading: Give the mail a head start.
timing.body: Printed letters travel with the post, and the post slows down as Christmas gets closer. Order with time to spare. If the date you care about is close, choose the email. faq.heading: Questions parents actually ask
faq.intro: Short answers. If yours is not here, the contact page is the other place to leave it.
faq.seoTitle: Santa Letter FAQ | Ordering, Dates, and Delivery
faq.seoDescription: Answers about Santa letters and emails: what to tell us, the North Pole postmark, when to order, and what happens before checkout opens.

items.q: What do I need to tell you?
items.a: The form on the product page. The child's name, age, and town, something they did well, and anything you want Santa to mention: a friend, a pet, a wish list, or something they are working on.

items.q: Where is the printed letter postmarked?
items.a: From the North Pole USPS facility. It arrives by post.
You pick the date. The email is sent from Santa's personal email address on that date. We do not publish the address itself on this site.

Printed letters travel with the mail, and the mail slows down late in the season. Order with time to spare. If the date you care about is close, choose the email, which goes out on the day you pick. We do not list a last-order day. That day changes every year, and we will not print a guess.

items.q: Can I order for two children?
items.a: Yes. Use a separate letter for each child so the details stay their own, or use the sibling bundle and mail both letters to one address.
The button says coming soon until a payment link is on that letter. You can still fill in the form and keep it in the cart on this device. Leave your email and we will be in touch.

items.q: Do you ship outside the United States?
items.a: The printed letter is mailed through the USPS North Pole facility, and this store is set up for the United States. An international option is not listed.

items.q: What if a detail is wrong?
items.a: Use the contact page as soon as you notice. If we made the mistake, we correct it. If the letter has already been mailed, it cannot be pulled out of the post.

shipping.heading: How the letter gets there
shipping.intro: Two different trips. The printed letter goes through the mail. The email goes out on a date you choose.
shipping.seoTitle: Santa Letter Shipping | North Pole Postmark and Email
shipping.seoDescription: Printed Santa letters are postmarked at the North Pole USPS facility and mailed in the United States. Emails go out on the date you choose.

sections.heading: Printed letters
sections.body: They are postmarked from the North Pole USPS facility and then travel with USPS. We do not publish a number of days, and we do not publish a last day to order. December is slower than October. Order with time to spare.

sections.heading: Emails
sections.body: You pick the delivery date on the form. The email is sent from Santa's personal email address on that date. Check the spam folder if the day arrives and the inbox looks empty, then write to us.

sections.heading: Where we ship
sections.body: The United States. An address outside the country is not an option on this site.

sections.heading: What the price covers
sections.body: The printed letter is $15.95 and the email is $6.95. The sibling bundle is $28.95. A separate shipping fee is not listed on this site.

about.heading: Written for one child
about.intro: You know the stories. We put them in a letter that looks like it came from the North Pole.
about.seoTitle: About Custom Letters from Santa Claus
about.seoDescription: Custom Letters from Santa Claus writes personalized letters and emails for a child in your life. Printed letters are postmarked from the North Pole.

sections.heading: What you do
sections.body: Answer a few questions. The name, the age, the town, a friend or a pet, something they did well, something they are working on, and a wish list. That is the letter.

sections.heading: What arrives
sections.body: A printed letter postmarked from the North Pole USPS facility, or an email from Santa's personal email address on the date you choose. The email address itself is not printed on this site.

sections.heading: Where the shop is
sections.body: The business is in Grayson, Louisiana. The postmark on a printed letter is the North Pole facility, which is the point.

contact.heading: A question before you order
contact.intro: The form on the letter you want is what we use to write it. Use this page for anything else.
contact.seoTitle: Contact | Custom Letters from Santa Claus
contact.seoDescription: Contact Custom Letters from Santa Claus about a letter or an email. Leave a note and we will be in touch.

sections.heading: What to use the form for
sections.body: A question about timing, two children, or a detail you are not sure how to phrase. The order itself belongs on the product page, so the answers stay attached to that letter.

privacy.heading: What we hold onto
privacy.intro: How this site handles the details you type, the cart in your browser, and a simple page view.
privacy.seoTitle: Privacy Policy | Custom Letters from Santa
privacy.seoDescription: How Custom Letters from Santa Claus handles the details you type, the cart saved in your browser, and the page view sent to our own server.

sections.heading: The details you type
sections.body: Names, ages, towns, stories, wish lists, dates, and mailing addresses are used to write and send the letter or email. Order them as the adult. We do not ask the child to use the site.

sections.heading: This browser
sections.body: The cart, and a notify-me note if you leave one, stay in local storage on this device. Clearing the browser clears them. They are not sent anywhere by that form.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not typed into this site. When a product has a payment link, that button sends you to the address in the catalog, and the details you entered are added to the link so they travel with the order. That checkout belongs to the payment provider.

sections.heading: Page views
sections.body: Opening a page sends a note to our own server with the path and the referrer. It is not an advertising network. We do not sell a list.

sections.heading: Email
sections.body: Leave your email on the contact page or with a coming-soon note. We will be in touch. The cart itself stays on this device.

terms.heading: Terms of sale
terms.intro: Plain terms for ordering a personalized letter or email from Santa.
terms.seoTitle: Terms of Sale | Custom Letters from Santa
terms.seoDescription: Terms for ordering a personalized Santa letter or email, including the details you supply and how payment works.

sections.heading: The offer
sections.body: The printed letter is $15.95. The email is $6.95. The sibling bundle is $28.95. Each page lists what that order includes.

sections.heading: Your details
sections.body: You are responsible for the spelling of the child's name and for the mailing address or email address you type. The letter is written from those answers.

sections.heading: The postmark and the date
sections.body: A printed letter is postmarked from the North Pole USPS facility. We do not promise a delivery day for the post. An email is sent on the date you choose, from Santa's personal email address.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: Card numbers are not typed into this site. When a product has a payment link, that link is where payment happens, and the price on the link is the price that is charged. Until a link is set, the button says coming soon and no order is placed.

sections.heading: The shop
sections.body: Custom Letters from Santa Claus, Grayson, Louisiana.

refunds.heading: If something is wrong
refunds.intro: Personalized letters cannot be un-mailed. This is how we handle a problem before that, and a mistake that is ours.
refunds.seoTitle: Refunds | Custom Letters from Santa Claus
refunds.seoDescription: Refunds for Santa letters and emails. A mailed letter cannot be pulled back. Tell us before it goes out if you need to cancel.

sections.heading: Before it goes out
sections.body: If you reach us before a printed letter is mailed, or before an email is sent, we cancel the order and return the payment.

sections.heading: If we get it wrong
sections.body: A name we mistyped, or an email that did not go on the date you chose, is ours to fix. Tell us as soon as you notice.

sections.heading: After it is mailed
sections.body: A letter that has entered the post cannot be recalled. If the mistake was in the details you sent, that is not a refund. If the mistake was ours, we send a replacement.
